signals.label: Hidden caps
signals.finding: The deal says "unlimited", but the vendor's own pages meter usage.

evidence.quote: You are allowed to install it on as many sites as your license permits, including on your clients’ sites, and charge them for the installation and usage of the plugin if it’s part of a larger service you’re offering, like creating a new site or maintaining one.

signals.label: Support complaints
signals.finding: 2 reviews (5.4% of all) say support is slow or gone.

evidence.quote: I would like to add that their support is very slow.
The only support is through a chat pop up, and it takes hours

signals.label: Tier trap
signals.finding: The cheapest tier is a usable slice of the product.

signals.label: Discount size
signals.finding: $59 vs a stated $99 regular price (40% off).

signals.label: One-sided change clauses
signals.finding: The terms let the vendor change the service.

evidence.quote: We do not have any price-lock-in guarantees. If you buy for $10 today and see a deal for $5 tomorrow we won’t refund you $5 nor upgrade your account to match the new limits.

claims.text: Prevents bots from reaching WordPress site

quote.text: Prevent bad guys & bots from messing with your WordPress site before they even get to it

claims.text: 3-code plan includes centralized dashboard for sites, licenses and IP lists

quote.text: Centralized dashboard for controlling sites, licenses & IP access lists

claims.text: Previous buyers can buy more codes to increase limits

quote.text: Previous AppSumo customers who purchased WP Login Lockdown can buy more codes to increase their feature limits

claims.text: Codes must be redeemed within 60 days of purchase

quote.text: You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase

claims.text: Plugin work happens in admin with no site slowdown

quote.text: Absolutely not. Everything the plugin does happens in the admin.

claims.text: No front-end loading and no impact on site performance

quote.text: Nothing is loaded, added, or processed on the front-end, so you can rest assured that there is no impact on the performance of your site.

claims.text: License can be moved between sites via deactivation

quote.text: Once you deactivate Login Lockdown on a site, the license goes back into your license pool, and you can activate it on another site.

claims.text: Dashboard shows all sites using licenses

quote.text: At any given time, you can see all sites using your licenses when you log in to the Login Lockdown Dashboard.

claims.text: Plugin makes no permanent changes and disabling undoes changes

quote.text: The plugin does not make any permanent changes to your site so even if it comes to a worst-case scenario you can just disable the plugin and that will undo all changes.

claims.text: Cloud Protection distributes blacklists and whitelists across managed websites

quote.text: Cloud Protection allows you to create unique blacklists & whitelists in one place and easily distribute them across all websites you manage.

claims.text: PRO version has ten times more features than free version

quote.text: The PRO version has ten times more features than the free one.

claims.text: 2FA sends confirmation email after each login attempt

quote.text: Login Lockdown can send a confirmation email after each login attempt, so even if someone steals your username & password they won’t be able to access your website.

finePrint.summary: Lifetime plans are sold as including lifetime updates and support plus all current and future features.

quote.text:
- 100 sites license

- Lifetime updates & support

- All current & future plugin features

- Cloud Blacklists

finePrint.summary: Buyers can compare lifetime pricing to a $9.99 per month cancellable option.

quote.text: Need the plugin only for a short time? Get it for ONLY $9.99 /month & cancel any time!

finePrint.summary: Lifetime-deal buyers get a 7-day no-questions-asked full refund guarantee.

quote.text: You are fully protected by our 100% Risk-Free Guarantee. If you don’t like the plugin over the next seven days, we will happily refund 100% of your money.

finePrint.summary: The refund window is 7 days, extended to 15 days after final delivery for presale purchases.

quote.text: We offer a 7-day no-questions-asked refund policy. If you buy Login Lockdown during the presale period, then the policy is extended to 15 days after we deliver the final version of the plugin to you.

finePrint.summary: Support is promised while the buyer holds a valid PRO license from in-house agents.

quote.text: Absolutely! While you have a valid PRO license our friendly, in-house support agents are at your disposal.

finePrint.summary: Support is handled in-house with most tickets answered by the plugin developers.

quote.text: We take support seriously! That’s why we never outsource it, and 9 out of 10 tickets are answered by Login Lockdown developers.

finePrint.summary: Use is capped by the number of sites allowed under the buyer's license.

quote.text: You are allowed to install it on as many sites as your license permits, including on your clients’ sites, and charge them for the installation and usage of the plugin if it’s part of a larger service you’re offering, like creating a new site or maintaining one.

finePrint.summary: Hostile behavior toward support can result in all communication being blocked.

quote.text: Any such actions will result in all communication being blocked. No exceptions.

finePrint.summary: There is no price or limit lock-in, so later deals or changed limits do not apply retroactively.

quote.text: We do not have any price-lock-in guarantees. If you buy for $10 today and see a deal for $5 tomorrow we won’t refund you $5 nor upgrade your account to match the new limits.

trials.claim: Prevents bots from reaching WordPress site
trials.claimQuote: Prevent bad guys & bots from messing with your WordPress site before they even get to it
trials.reasoning: The vendor states it can block bots from the login form or entire site, and a buyer confirms efficient blocking of attackers and bots via .htaccess, with no contrary exhibit.

exhibits.quote: Block bots from accessing your login form or the entire site.
exhibits.argument: Vendor directly states the product blocks bots from the login form or entire site.

exhibits.quote: Under the hood, it leverages .htaccess, which has proven to be a highly efficient method for blocking attackers and bots.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the product efficiently blocks attackers and bots via .htaccess.

trials.claim: 3-code plan includes centralized dashboard for sites, licenses and IP lists
trials.claimQuote: Centralized dashboard for controlling sites, licenses & IP access lists
trials.reasoning: The vendor describes controlling purchases, licenses, sites and Cloud Blacklists from a single location, and a buyer confirms the centralised dashboard helps manage multiple installations. The prosecution exhibit only concerns changing settings site-by-site, not the claimed sites, licenses and IP lists.

exhibits.quote: Currently if you have many websites and need to change a setting, you'll need to go through site by site taking you hours of time.
exhibits.argument: Dashboard does not allow centralized control of settings, requiring site-by-site changes.

exhibits.quote: Control all your purchases, licenses, sites & Cloud Blacklists from a single location
exhibits.argument: Vendor describes centralized dashboard controlling licenses, sites and Cloud Blacklists.

exhibits.quote: The centralised dashboard makes managing multiple client installations painless
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms centralized dashboard makes managing multiple installations painless.

trials.claim: Plugin work happens in admin with no site slowdown
trials.claimQuote: Absolutely not. Everything the plugin does happens in the admin.
trials.reasoning: The vendor also describes lightweight server-level protection and a buyer says it works via .htaccess, which conflicts with the claim that everything happens only in the admin, even though no slowdown was reported.

exhibits.quote: Lightweight, server-level protection against malicious requests, bad bots, automated attacks, spam, and many other threats.
exhibits.argument: Vendor describes server-level protection, contradicting admin-only processing with no front-end impact.

exhibits.quote: it leverages .htaccess, which has proven to be a highly efficient method for blocking attackers and bots.
exhibits.argument: Plugin works via .htaccess server-level blocking, not solely in admin.

exhibits.quote: Absolutely not. Everything the plugin does happens in the admin.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states all plugin work happens in admin with no slowdown.

exhibits.quote: the plugin runs smoothly in the background without slowing down my website.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms plugin runs without slowing down website.

trials.claim: Previous buyers can buy more codes to increase limits
trials.claimQuote: Previous AppSumo customers who purchased WP Login Lockdown can buy more codes to increase their feature limits
trials.reasoning: The terms exhibit only says the vendor will not refund a price difference or upgrade an account to match a later deal's limits. It does not directly address whether previous buyers can buy more codes to increase their limits, and no supporting exhibit is shown.

exhibits.quote: If you buy for $10 today and see a deal for $5 tomorrow we won’t refund you $5 nor upgrade your account to match the new limits.
exhibits.argument: Vendor refuses to upgrade accounts to match new limits, undermining stacking to increase limits.
